about_the_game:
Polly's Gone is a unique blend of action-RTS and shoot'em up elements, where you embark on a journey to find the missing Polly, joined by a loyal team of sheep. Progress through levels, face new challenges, and overcome dangers to get closer to uncovering Polly's whereabouts.

Polly's Gone offers two exciting game modes:

  • Story Mode: Dive into the story and explore various levels while tactically guiding your team and defeating enemies.

  • Survival Mode: Test your skills in a challenging 10-minute survival arena on a lost island, where your team’s fate rests in your hands.

Prepare for dynamic battles, unique environments, and thrilling challenges in this action-packed adventure!

content_descriptors.notes: The game shows the death of low polygon animals, but no animal was injured during the making of the game.
